name: New Orleans Bananas Foster Sundae
whyItWorks: Warm caramelized bananas in rum-butterscotch sauce over vanilla ice cream; soft cooked bananas are a classic soluble-fiber fruit.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask to hold any toasted pecan or almond garnish on top and pair with a Lactaid pill for the vanilla ice cream.
watchOuts: Liquid dairy ice cream and butter-sugar sauce
